title: a successor passed to test.is is compared and counts as used
purpose: Run embedded tests and observe the exit status.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status); exit 0 means every assertion held.

provenance.origin: authored for #275 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.1 (call arguments consume successors) and 14: test.is compares with structural equality; a successor passed directly or through a binding is an ordinary argument.
